clips.image: A young female flight engineer in a fitted black technical jacket, headset around her neck, sits at a console in a dark mission control room; her face is lit cyan by screens; she slowly looks up toward a huge wall display of satellite orbits
clips.motion: slow push-in on her face as she lifts her eyes to the wall screen, screen light flickers across her face, subtle handheld

clips.image: Wide shot of a sleek mission control room: rows of young engineers (mixed genders and ethnicities, stylish, in their twenties) at curved consoles, a giant wall screen showing Earth with 32 glowing orbit lines
clips.motion: fast lateral dolly along the console row, engineers typing, screens pulse to the beat, energetic

clips.image: Close-up of hands on a backlit keyboard and a monitor showing streaming green and cyan numbers and orbital plots, a young male engineer with rolled-up sleeves leaning in
clips.motion: rapid rack focus from the fingers to his intense eyes reflected in the monitor, numbers scroll, kinetic

clips.image: Moody wide shot from the back of a dark mission control room: a young, mixed crew in their twenties (women and men of different ethnicities, casual-technical clothes, one in a hoodie) seen from behind at consoles, warm amber desk lamps, a wall-sized screen with a world map and sine-wave satellite ground tracks
clips.motion: slow crane down from ceiling height toward the consoles, calm, atmospheric haze in the screen light

clips.image: Extreme close-up of @maya wearing glasses; reflected in her lenses are two analog clocks drifting apart
clips.motion: very slow push-in, she blinks, the reflected numbers tick, shallow focus, quiet

clips.image: Two young engineers, a man and a woman, at a glass whiteboard covered in handwritten relativity equations and orbit sketches, one of them writing with a marker
clips.motion: handheld arc around them as she writes and he points at the equation, they exchange a quick look and a smile

clips.image: A mission control team of young engineers jumps up from their consoles celebrating, high-fives, the wall screen behind them shows a satellite lock on a glowing Earth
clips.motion: explosive cheer and high-fives in slow motion, camera pushes through the group toward the wall screen, euphoric

clips.image: Photorealistic photograph of the satellite in @render, same satellite design, same camera angle and composition: a GPS navigation satellite with a gold-foil box body and two long solar wings, drifting in medium Earth orbit
clips.motion: slow, steady push-in toward the satellite, sunlight glints travel across the gold foil and the solar cells, stars stay fixed, majestic

clips.image: Photorealistic close photograph of the satellite in @render, same design and framing: gold multi-layer insulation, silver radiators, deep-blue solar wings
clips.motion: fast orbiting camera move around the satellite, a lens flare sweeps as the Sun passes behind a solar wing, punchy

clips.image: Photorealistic photograph of the International Space Station as in @render, same composition, above the curved limb of Earth with a thin blue atmosphere line and clouds below
clips.motion: the station glides forward over the Earth's limb, the terminator line slides across the clouds, camera tracks alongside

clips.image: Photorealistic macro photograph of the Earth-facing antenna panel in @render: twelve white helical L-band antennas in a ring on a dark plate, gold-foil satellite body beside them
clips.motion: slow macro slide across the helical antennas with shallow depth of field, rack focus from the near helix to the far ones, Earth glow reflects on the metal

clips.image: Photorealistic photograph of the Hubble Space Telescope as in @render, same framing: a long silver-foil cylindrical telescope with its round aperture door hinged open at the front end, two flat rectangular solar array wings on the sides, against the glowing limb of Earth. Not a station module, no docking ports
clips.motion: the telescope rotates slowly as the camera arcs around it, sunlight rakes across its silver insulation, serene

clips.image: Young mission control crew in their twenties facing camera at their consoles, warm desk lamps and teal screens
clips.motion: slow push-in along the line of faces, they look up at the wall screen together

clips.image: From orbit at dusk: hundreds of flat square mirror satellites (each a thin silver reflective sheet about 50 metres across on a slim frame) fly in a vast sun-synchronous formation along the terminator, every mirror tilted toward the same point, their beams converging into one brilliant shaft of sunlight that lights a large solar farm in bright daylight on the dark night side of Earth, surrounded by orange city lights
clips.motion: slow pull-back revealing more and more mirrors joining the formation, beams converge and the lit circle on the ground brightens as each mirror locks on, epic and serene

clips.image: A professional observatory telescope (open-truss corrected Dall-Kirkham astrograph on a massive direct-drive alt-az mount, like @scope) in a dome on a mountain at night, a thin bright green laser beam fires from the telescope straight up into the starry sky toward a satellite
clips.motion: low-angle shot, the dome slit glows, the green ranging laser pulses rhythmically into the stars, the telescope tracks smoothly, stars drift slightly

clips.image: Close-up of a precision research telescope (open carbon-fibre truss, large primary mirror, direct-drive mount, like @scope) tracking across the night sky inside an open observatory, a tiny bright satellite visible as a point between the stars
clips.motion: the telescope slews smoothly and locks on, camera slowly orbits the truss, reflections glide across the mirror, stars sharp

clips.image: Photorealistic photograph of the formation in @render, same layout and camera angle: hundreds of orbital data-center satellites in a vast grid over Earth, each with a gold-foil compute hall, a large dark square solar array and two vertical radiator wings glowing orange-red with waste heat, Earth's clouds and blue limb below, black space above
clips.motion: camera glides through the formation as modules pass close by, radiators shimmer with heat glow, sunlight flares across the arrays, epic scale

clips.image: Close-up of one orbital data-center module in the style of @dcref: server racks visible through a viewport, a huge deployable radiator panel glowing deep orange-red with infrared heat, liquid-cooling pipes and heat pipes, a dark solar array behind, Earth's blue limb beyond
clips.motion: slow push along the glowing radiator fins, heat shimmer, the Earth's limb rotates slowly behind, detailed and believable

clips.image: Close tracking shot along a line of flat square orbital mirror satellites, thin silver reflective sheets on lightweight frames with small thruster pods, catching blinding sunlight; dozens more stretch away in formation toward Earth's terminator below
clips.motion: camera slides past the nearest mirror as it slowly tilts and flashes the sun at the lens, the formation recedes to the horizon

clips.image: Seen through a tall glass wall from the other side: a young engineer writes a long general-relativity equation with a white marker directly on the glass, the handwriting glowing in the screen light, a vast wall display of satellite orbits behind her, a colleague watching
clips.motion: camera slides slowly along the glass as the marker moves, the writing catches reflections of the orbit screens, focus pulls from the ink to her face

clips.image: Wide shot of a glass wall completely covered in handwritten physics equations, integrals and orbit sketches, a young mixed team silhouetted behind it against a giant glowing Earth display with hundreds of satellite tracks
clips.motion: slow dolly through the gap in the glass wall into the room, equations slide past in the foreground, parallax, dramatic

styles.crew: photorealistic cinematic film still, shot on ARRI Alexa 65, anamorphic 40mm, shallow depth of field, dark modern mission control room lit by wall-sized screens of orbit tracks and a glowing Earth plus warm amber practical desk lamps, teal and amber color grade, subtle film grain, private-spaceflight aesthetic, no logos, no brand names, any on-screen text soft and unreadable
styles.space: photorealistic NASA documentary photograph from orbit, shot on 70mm, real spacecraft materials: crinkled gold and silver multi-layer insulation, mirrored radiator tiles, deep blue solar cells with fine silver grid lines, bolts and cabling; hard direct sunlight, pure black space, Earth with real clouds and atmosphere glow; no text, no logos
styles.night: photorealistic astrophotography-grade cinematic shot, dark-sky mountain observatory at night, Milky Way overhead, deep blue night with dim red safelights, crisp stars, shot on ARRI Alexa 65 with fast prime lens, no logos, no readable text
styles.future: photorealistic near-future space documentary, real engineering detail: truss structures, huge flat radiator panels, solar arrays, cabling, thermal blankets; hard sunlight, black space, Earth with real clouds below; restrained, believable, no logos, no text
